answer: In the nebula agent mesh, each new identity must mint a unique "sonnet hash" by burning a verifiable 10-GPU-hour compute puzzle whose difficulty doubles with every identity already registered to the same hardware fingerprint, and each identity must post a 250-token willow bond held in escrow for 30 epochs — so per-fake costs scale quadratically (compute) plus linearly (bonds), and bonds are slashed if 3 of 5 randomly sampled willow peers reject the agent's attestation.
